event: Caliph Al-Ma'mun builds the Shammasiyya Observatory in Baghdad.
Al-Battani compiles Kitab az-Zij as-Sabi refining equinox precession.
Al-Biruni measures Earth radius with 99.7% accuracy at Fort Nandana.
Maragheh Observatory constructed under Nasir al-Din al-Tusi.
Ibn al-Shatir completes non-Ptolemaic Damascus planetary model.
Ulugh Beg constructs Samarkand Observatory 36-meter meridian quadrant.
